root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: all declared arg_list[] lengths fit between p and end before decoding continues
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the dirty-job decode gate, the decision to continue decoding arguments must agree with whether a full replay of arg_list[] from p stays within end.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable run still permits argument decoding even though the remaining TACACS argument-length table already over-claims the packet. The fixed run reaches the same gate with the decode decision aligned to that full-table fit predicate, so the malformed witness is rejected before any earlier argument is parsed.

nodes.state: At the base16 validator sink, the promoted input byte is 255 while the last valid index of fr_base16_alphabet_decode_mc[UINT8_MAX] is 254, so alphabet[(uint8_t)c] performs the saved one-byte global-buffer-overflow read.

edges.relation: Because the vulnerable decoder permits dirty-job parsing on a malformed remaining length table, execution still reaches the octet hex-decoding call in fr_value_box_from_str().
The same hex-input base pointer passed from fr_value_box_from_str() into fr_base16_decode() becomes the base pointer consumed by fr_base16_decode_nstd().
The offending 0xff byte at the current base16 decode step is passed unchanged into fr_is_base16_nstd() and used as the sink table index.
